summary: RC.B.5 is complete and conformant. The new ff-volume crate is a genuinely narrow in-memory model: its Cargo.toml depends ONLY on ff-vfs + thiserror/serde/chrono with no ff-dscatalog/ff-dsalloc/ff-idcams edge, keeping the ff-dscatalog -> ff-volume -> ff-vfs DAG acyclic. The two space failures are DISTINCT VolumeError variants (SpaceAbend for the dataset x37 family, VolumeFull for volume capacity); extent.rs::accommodate checks max_extents before charging the volume and the Volume_Full branch returns before pushing any extent, so Volume_Full consumes no extent (Req 5.5/7.3/7.4), each proven by a dedicated test. Geometry is deterministic integer ceil math with the documented 3390-style defaults (56664 bytes/track, 15 tracks/cyl) and the worked example 1,000,000 bytes -> 18 tracks -> 2 cylinders is asserted. Schema v4 bumps SCHEMA_VERSION to '4', adds both volumes and dataset_volumes tables (in initialize_database and as the MIGRATIONS index-2 entry with correct idx=v-1 arithmetic), and the pre-existing version-string tests are updated from '3' to '4' with new v4 tests added. The v3->v4 seed (schema_v4::migrate_v3_to_v4, wired into Catalog::mount after validate_schema) is dual-read and idempotent, moves no bytes, derives each locator from storage_path, and does NOT drop storage_path. Resolution (catalog_resolve::resolve_locator) walks Dataset -> dataset_volumes (ordered) -> volumes with an Online check reporting the first unavailable volume via the new CatalogError::VolumeUnavailable, and falls back to repo_root.join(storage_path) for unmigrated rows; the DatasetVolume path yields the same physical path as the legacy path, so downstream readers keep working. Multivolume, shared-registry, and uncataloged VOL=SER+UNIT paths exist in ff-volume and are delegated to from the catalog layer, with a 6-test integration suite in tests/schema_v4.rs. Every test carries a // Validates: Requirement comment; new .rs files are ASCII-only and under 400 non-test lines (extent.rs ~227, volume.rs ~345); the pre-existing catalog.rs >400 violation was not grown (new concerns split into catalog_resolve.rs/schema_v4.rs). Scope stayed within RC.B.5: no DatasetAccess trait, no VSAM wiring, no command dispatch/WorkspaceContext (contract is data-only consts/descriptors), no crate deletion, and nothing is committed (HEAD remains the pre-task CR-CH-058 commit). Unrelated modified files in the working tree (ff-desktop shell, ff-dscatalog service.rs/vsam_service.rs, other specs' docs) belong to other parallel tasks sharing this tree and are outside RC.B.5's diff. One non-blocking documentation note: the TCR gained a correct new RC.B.5 PASS section, but the original volume-model phase rows for the same criteria remain marked NOT COVERED (red) rather than being updated in place, leaving duplicate contradictory rows; this is doc hygiene only and does not affect any acceptance criterion. The ff-governance-tests DAG allow-list and downstream storage_path readers are correctly flagged for the owner's full gate rather than changed here.
